criteria.title: Word count within limit
criteria.description: The output must have no more than 180 words, counted by splitting on whitespace after removing markdown symbols like '**' and '-' (target is about 150; your failing outputs had 211–254 words).

criteria.title: No gender or age PII
criteria.description: The output must not match any of these case-insensitive regexes: gendered pronouns \b(he|she|him|her|his|hers|himself|herself)\b; gender words \b(male|female|man|woman|boy|girl|mr|mrs|ms)\b; ages \d+[- ]year[- ]old or \bage[sd]?\s+\d+.

criteria.title: All six keys as bullets in order
criteria.description: The output must have exactly six bullet lines starting with '- ' (bold like '**key:**' is allowed), one each for 'chief complaint:', 'history of present illness:', 'physical examination:', 'symptoms', 'medications' and 'follow-up' (case-insensitive), in that order, with no other content.

criteria.title: Faithful to transcript
criteria.description: Every finding, symptom, medication, dosage, vital sign and instruction in the output must be stated in or directly implied by the transcript, with nothing made up or contradicted.

criteria.title: Medications and follow-up complete with correct N/A use
criteria.description: If the transcript mentions new or changed medications or follow-up instructions, the output must list them (with dosages for medications when given); it uses 'N/A' only when the transcript truly has no such information.
